notes.title: ☄️ Appulse Demo Ending ☄️
notes.content:
🚀 The current Appulse free demo trial is now over ! 🚀 


We gathered of lot of feedback during the time our demo was up. It was very interesting to hear what gamers had to say to our concept, and we are currently actively working on the main issues, such as the frustration to lose your flippers. We are already improving gameplay by adding healing abilities and a better onboarding.



Therefore, we would like to give huge thanks to all the people who participated to our event and to the AG French Direct who featured us. We really hope you liked what you discovered in Appulse, and that you want more! 



We are cooking brand new mechanics, featuring meta progression and new boards so watch out for any news from us, we may release a new demo in the upcoming month 🔥 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/dde787c50039b90d99bd80921d1351a931bf75eb.png"]

notes.title: ☄️ Appulse Demo now available ☄️
notes.content:
🚀 The time has finally come, the demo of Appulse is out now! 🚀 

Appulse is currently featured in the AG French Direct, a special event focused on upcoming french games, where our new demo has been revealed.

We are excited to show a new version of our game, with refined visuals, improved gameplay, new perks and new enemies.

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/0fdd3ec9950436a4dd34d31cd344101e19247237.png
[hr][/hr]
Download the demo now, embark on your spaceship and beat all waves of enemies.
Will you be up to the challenge?

[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535693/36828514148069edf579fc7b01d6b16effb4b090.png
[hr][/hr]
